item.text: {"ticker":"LLY","status":"success","report":"This report is for educational use only and is not financial advice. MCP returned a successful FCFF valuation for Eli Lilly and Company in USD. The model estimates value per share at $845.15 versus a current market price of $1,065.00. Growth assumptions are high: revenue growth is 14.81% next year, 16.88% for years 2-5, then fades toward 4.6% terminal growth. Margins start from a very strong base, with operating margin at 53.18% in the base year, 53.0% next year, and a long-run target of 41.61%. Reinvestment is modeled through sales-to-capital: 1.47x in years 1-5 and 1.01x in years 6-10, implying material capital needs to support projected growth. Cost of capital is 9.79% initially and 9.63% in the terminal period, with a 4.6% risk-free rate and Damodaran country/equity risk inputs. Terminal value is a major part of the result: terminal cash flow is $76.84B, terminal value is $1.527T, and present value of terminal value is $378.84B, compared with $414.40B present value of explicit cash flows. Data caveats: market data came through Yahoo Finance via the local yfinance service and may be missing, stale, or incomplete; the growth anchor maps LLY to Drugs (Pharmaceutical), United States, 2026, with 231 firms and confidence 1.0; rates are shown in percent and sales-to-capital as a multiple."}
